'''Ernst Peter Fischer''' (born 18 January 1947) is a [[Germans|German]] Historian of Science and Publicist.

==Life and work==
Ernst Peter Fischer studied mathematics, physics, and biology and graduated from the [[California Institute of Technology]] in 1977. In 1987, he qualified as a university lecturer in the history of science, and taught as a professor at the [[University of Konstanz]]. Between 1989 and 1999 he was the publisher of the ''Mannheimer Forum.[https://mannheim-forum.org/en]'' This position was previously held by [[Hoimar von Ditfurth]].

During his free time, Fischer engaged in scientific journalism, as well as spending time as a mentor. He worked as a publisher for the ''Stiftung Forum für Verantwortung''.[https://www.forum-fuer-verantwortung.de/]

As a science publisher, Fisher wrote articles for several newspapers. Among them were ''[[GEO (magazine)|GEO]]'', ''Bild der Wissenschaft'', ''[[Die Weltwoche]]'' and the ''[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]]''.

== Awards ==
Fischer's published work has received multiple awards.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.econ-referenten.de/redner/fischer-prof-dr-ernst-peter-wissenschaftshistoriker-bestseller-autor/|title=Prof. Dr. Ernst Peter Fischer Wissenschaftshistoriker, Bestseller-Autor|website=www.econ-referenten.de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Ernst Peter Fischer |url=https://www.cshl.edu/oral-history/ernst-peter-fischer/ |access-date=2024-03-25 |website=Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory |language=en-US}}</ref>

* 1980: Heinrich-Bechold-Medaille
* 1981: Preis der wissenschaftlichen Gesellschaft Freiburg
* 2002: Lorenz-Oken-Medaille
* 2003: Treviranus-Medaille
* 2003: Eduard-Rhein-Kulturpreis
* 2004: Medaille für Naturwissenschaftliche Publizistik<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.dpg-physik.de/preise/preistraeger_np.html|title=Preisträger Naturwiss. Publizistik nach Jahren|date=July 13, 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110713092609/http://www.dpg-physik.de/preise/preistraeger_np.html|archive-date=2011-07-13}}</ref> der [[Deutsche Physikalische Gesellschaft|Deutschen Physikalischen Gesellschaft]]
* 2004: Sartorius-Preis<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uni-goettingen.de/de/20570.html|title=Akademie: Auszeichnungen für Wissenschaftler |volume= 4/2004 |date= December 2004 |page=15|publisher=University of Göttingen}}</ref> der [[Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen]]
* 2011: Honorary member of the Naturforschende Gesellschaft zu Emden
